label: Artemis II Mission Status
delta: Day 29 post-splashdown: Orion de-servicing at MPPF progressing (heat shield visual inspection ongoing; Marshall X-ray scans summer 2026). Artemis III SLS core stage VAB integration advancing. Starship IFT-12 cleared for launch (NET May 12–18) after Booster 19 successful full 33-engine static fire May 7. Crew week-5 reconditioning; Artemis Accords at 67 nations.
deltaNote: Formal heat shield X-ray scans and Avcoat sample extractions at Marshall Space Flight Center scheduled summer 2026. Artemis IV 2028 crewed landing timeline to be confirmed after Marshall analysis. IFT-12 (window May 12–18) is first flight of Starship V3; tests docking port and propellant-transfer hardware critical for Artemis III HLS Earth-orbit rendezvous and docking in 2027.
